# Leeframes Studio

> Leeframes Studio is a Seoul creative studio, founded in 2026, making art-directed AI lookbooks and Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ad creatives for DTC fashion, beauty and lifestyle brands. Every image is art-directed by hand and produced with AI, so there is no photoshoot.

## Services

- AI lookbooks: a full season of editorial imagery per collection (10–15 final images), from a direction board approved before production
- Meta ad creatives: static and carousel ads, image only with no copy, in 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16, delivered every 2 weeks as a subscription
- Creative only: Leeframes does not run media buying; it works alongside the brand's in-house team or agency

## Who it works with

DTC brands that sell online and run Meta ads, especially fashion, accessory, beauty and lifestyle brands. Brands in the portfolio include 6A, Akoihaus, Cleartype, Coffery, Produktepr and YAR.

## How it works

Four steps: brief, first drafts (two revision rounds included), final files, then a next batch built on what performed.

## Contact

Get a quote: https://leeframes.com/quote.html or hello@leeframes.com
